senses.gloss:
f. (-लुः)
A small water pot.
E.
ऋ to go, and उच् affix, र becomes ल; also आलु.

f. (-लुः)
A pitcher, a small water jar.
mn. (-लुः-लु)
1 An esculent root, (Arum campanulatum); in the modern dialects this name is applied to the yam, potatoe, &c.
2 A raft, a float.
m. (-लुः)
An owl.
E.
ऋ to go, and उण् affix, आरु what goes, (in the earth, water, &c.) the initial is lengthened, and र is changed to ल.

mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
Moderate, content, not covetous.
E.
अ, and लुब्ध covetous.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Uncut, unshorn.
E.
अ neg. लून cut.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Cut, cut off.
E.
आङ् before लून cut.

m. (-कः)
1 A name of the chief of the Nāgas or serpent race: see शेष.
2 An esculent root: see आलु.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.
